ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones are concentrated on the distal edges of both lobes. The left lobe (viewed) displays a fan-like distribution of white striations extending from the tip toward the center. The right lobe (viewed) features a large, irregular white blob with scattered mottling at its inner boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-10 pixels along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks are present on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve; concave trajectory immediately lateral to the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several isolated, circular white pixel clusters (approximately 3-6 pixels in diameter) distributed in the lower-central dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of high-contrast white linear marks across the central and right lobes. Multiple sets of parallel rake marks are visible, particularly a set of four distinct parallel lines on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the majority of the black pigmented area and significant irregular scarring on the right lobe distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white 'spray' pattern of fine lines on the left-most edge and a localized dark circular spot within the white patch on the right lobe tip.
